reviews.title: No customer service
reviews.text: The oath for contacting customer service is non existent.

reviews.title: Payment portion not working
reviews.text: The payment portion of the app is not working and it is nearly impossible to find a human to speak to about it. I had to use the website to make a purchase.

reviews.title: Loving Typology!
reviews.text: Every product, especially the tinted moisturizer. Every product I’ve tried has show results! I’m a redhead, I’m picky about my skin care products and make up as it is limited do to my skin tone and a mix of freckles and very fair skin.  My skin is also sensitive and easily sensitive to heat and cold weather. The tinted moisturizer is fabulous, the tinted lip oil, is luxurious. The correcteur anti-rougeurs is the best!! I wake up with a red tint on my face it immediately vanishes with this product!!!

reviews.title: Packaging Problem
reviews.text: Specifically the small glass containers with screw top pullout applicators. Once you’ve used two thirds of the product it becomes annoyingly tedious to try and get a decent amount out of the bottle at one time. I had to tip mine over into an empty contact lens case in the end and it took what felt like forever. I like the product a lot but it’s not cheap so a redesign making it easier to get it all out would be nice.

reviews.title: Top of the line 👌🏻

reviews.title: Best tinted face care ever
reviews.text: I don't feel like I am wearing anything, actually even better I feel hydrated. The concealer is amazing!! My daughter even noticed and said how good I looked! Same with my daughter's esthetician she was impressed with my skin!!!

reviews.title: Gentle and effective
reviews.text: I have extremely sensitive skin  with rosacea-even in my eyes. Their under eye cream, serum and concealer are so good! It does not irritate my eyes and I no longer have issues with puffiness or bags. Their lip oils are beautiful and moisturizing and their glow drops add a lovely glow without being shiny or glittery. I have not been disappointed with anything I’ve gotten!

reviews.title: I like this brand…..BUT
reviews.text: I don’t wanna keep doing questions every time I turn around. I want to find the products. I like a lot of these products. But I want easy reordering and I want to see all products easily and this new update isn’t making that easy.  and isn’t that what the apps are for? I don’t know is it only me that can’t see my history of purchases past the last one??  I really do like the products but if you can’t remember the three times I’ve input my information or any of my purchases from the last two years besides the very last one what is the point?

reviews.title: Exceptional
reviews.text:
I highly recommend this brand. My skin has responded to it so well over the last couple of years. My rosacea has calmed, my skin glows and most importantly, I feel good about the ingredients I am wearing everyday. The only thing I dislike is that they have discontinued a (beloved product) that I am now almost out of. Please please bring back the Targeted Blemish Treatment L65
1% Bakuchiol + Tea Tree Oil! It completely stops my rosacea related acne from persisting.
